plans.name: Moderato
plans.note: Agent credit values are approximate and based on typical task token consumption. Monthly credits are converted to the equivalent number of tasks for the same feature and are for reference only. Membership features share a single credit pool metered by token usage. “4× speed” is the official relative priority-queue wording.
